title: CLI echoes Authorization header passed via --header

fixtures.name: mcp add with literal Authorization --header is denied

tool_input.command: claude mcp add --transport http fake-srv https://mcp.example.test --header 'Authorization: Bearer FAKESECRET_tok_D3'

fixtures.policy_note: R3: the literal Authorization value is written by the command into MCP config (a persistent file), so the command is denied. R3 allows a literal only when the command uses it and shows its output without persisting it (see LEAK-1019).

fixtures.name: echoed Authorization header in stdout is masked, name and server intact
